name: A Donation of Wool
summary: In Orgrimmar, A Donation of Wool asks for help gathering cloth. The city has wool in its stores and expects more donors to bring in enough for the drive.

sections.title: Wool for Orgrimmar
sections.body: Orgrimmar asks you to give sixty pieces of wool cloth. In return, the city promises recognition. Its stores already hold some wool, and other donors are expected to help support the drive.

faq.answer: Orgrimmar is accepting donations of wool cloth.

faq.q: How much wool do I need to donate?
faq.answer: Orgrimmar asks for sixty pieces of wool cloth.

faq.q: What do I get for donating wool?
faq.answer: You earn full recognition from Orgrimmar for donating sixty pieces of wool cloth.
Orgrimmar is gathering wool to support its donation drive.
Yes. Orgrimmar has wool in its stores and expects other donors to bring in enough for the drive.
